title: Refuse a backticked Check entry that is not a command, in the spec check, the spec draft and ork run

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
ork runs every backticked entry in a slice's Check section. S508 made the plan warn about an entry that is not a command, but the warning does not stop the run. The run starts, fails later at the slice checks with "exec: X: executable file not found", and sits paused until someone edits the Check text. Between 2026-11-22 and 2026-11-25 this stopped six runs: S249, S250, S261 and S233 (`.scratch/`), S535 (`q quit` in an acceptance line) and S545 (a test name). The last two came from Check sections that the spec check itself drafted ("tighten" answers), so the spec check writes the entries that later fail.

Owner decision 2026-11-25 (interactive question), recorded in the slice's notes: a code gate everywhere.
- `run.start` and `wave.start` refuse when `SliceCheckCommandWarnings` is non-empty, and name each line.
- The spec check reports the item not ready with a deterministic finding.
- A drafted Check section is checked the same way, and the problem is attached to the section so it cannot be applied.
- An entry whose first word is a path listed in the slice's Files is not refused.

All of this happens before any role starts. This reverses S508's "never refuses a start".

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestSliceCheckCommandWarningsExemptsAFilesPath in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: Files paths scripts/new-check.sh, internal/cli:12-20 and ./tools/x.sh exempt matching command first words; internal/other still warns. Cover leading ./ and environment assignments.
- TestSpecDraftRefusesACheckEntryThatIsNotACommand in `internal/engine/specdraft_test.go`: changed Check gives separate Check problems for q quit and TestFoo; real commands, acceptance criteria, HUMAN CHECK, AFTER LAND and unchanged Check are excluded. Changed Files supplies exemptions; unchanged Files uses current slice Files. RunSpecDraft attaches problems.
- TestPlanWarnsOnANonCommandCheckEntry in `internal/daemon/runs_test.go:4182`: preserve warning text; warned plans refuse and create no run; clean plans and Files-exempt paths start.
- TestRunStartRefusesANonCommandCheckEntry in `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: refusal names both entries and item, plan warnings unchanged, no run created; fixed Check starts.
- TestWaveStartRefusesAMemberWithANonCommandCheckEntry in `internal/daemon/wave_test.go`: refuse bad S1 alone and start good S2.
- TestSpecCheckReportsNotReadyForANonCommandCheckEntry in `internal/daemon/speccheck_test.go`: deterministic finding holds bad item without role or questions; good batch member unaffected; fixed Check recomputed.
- TestWaveStartHoldsAnItemWithACheckFinding in `internal/cli/wave_test.go`: print held finding, omit item from confirmation and start, ask no question for it.
- TestSpecNoteNamesACheckFinding in `internal/tui/speccheck_test.go`: show finding instead of zero-question text.
- TestLaunchCheckFindingNamesTheEditBeforeRetry in `internal/tui/launch_test.go`: the actual Roadmap view at 80x24 and 120x40, in color and ASCII, shows the finding followed by "edit Check, then l starts the launch again". Existing question-skip status keeps its current wording.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and see each red. In `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`, first change `TestPlanWarnsOnANonCommandCheckEntry` to expect the refusal.
2. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, split `SliceCheckCommandWarnings` so one function takes the command entries, the Files paths and the worktree. `SliceCheckCommandWarnings(raw, worktree)` keeps its signature and reads the Files paths from the slice's Files section. Read them like `sliceTouchesUI` in `internal/engine/states.go:831`: backticked paths, `lineAnchor` removed, a leading `./` trimmed. Skip an entry whose first word, after any leading NAME=value words, equals one of those paths. Add a function that checks a Check body given as text, for the draft; it uses the same extraction as `sliceCheckCommands`, with its acceptance-criteria, human-check and after-land rules.
3. In `internal/engine/specdraft.go`, add `CheckDraftCheck(root string, secs []SpecDraftSection, raw []byte) []SpecDraftProblem`. For a changed Check section, it returns one `SpecDraftProblem{Section: "Check"}` per refused entry, using the warning text. The Files paths come from the draft's own Files section when it is changed, else from the slice's Files in `raw`. In `RunSpecDraft`, append its problems to `CheckDraftFiles(...)`. `specDraftApply` in `internal/daemon/specdraft.go` already refuses a section that has a problem, so it needs no change.
4. In `internal/daemon/runs.go`, have `planRun` hold the result of `engine.SliceCheckCommandWarnings` in an unexported field of `RunPlan`, and also append it to `plan.Warnings` as today. The unexported field keeps the plan JSON, and so the `expected` comparison, unchanged. In `startRunReply`, after the no-check refusal and before `restoreRunSpecAnswers`, return `&ipc.Error{Code: CodeRefused, ...}` when that field is non-empty. The message names the item, each line, and the fix: edit the Check section, then start again. `handleRun` and `startWave` both reach it, so a wave member with a bad Check fails alone, as a spec-gate failure does.
5. In `internal/daemon/speccheck.go`, make `specCheck` compute `engine.SliceCheckCommandWarnings(raw, proj.Path)` for each item right after the fingerprint. The project checkout stands in for the worktree, as in `planRun`. An item with findings is reported not ready with the lines, in a new findings list on the item's spec check result: Ready false, no questions, and no role runs for it (owner 2026-11-25, spec.check-command-finding). Keep the result out of `d.runs.specs`, so it is recomputed on every check.
6. In `internal/cli/wave.go`, print each finding of a not-ready item as `held: ITEM: LINE` and keep the item out of the start set. In `internal/tui/speccheck.go`, make `specNote` return the finding text. This touches `internal/cli` output and `internal/tui`, so the relay needs a UI pass (AGENTS.md, rule u10).
7. Docs: update `docs/design.md` plan warnings (a warned Check entry now refuses `run.start` and each `wave.start` member, and the spec check and the draft report it) and add one sentence to `docs/guide.md` "Writing Check lines". Changelog entry: `slicer changelog add S563 --text "..."`.
8. Answer text in a spec check question or an Owner decisions paragraph is not checked (owner 2026-11-25, spec.answer-command-text: out of this slice).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A start of a slice whose Check holds a backticked entry that is not a command is refused before any role starts, and the message names each such line.
- The spec check reports such an item not ready with a finding that names the line.
- A drafted Check section with such an entry gets a problem and cannot be applied.
- An entry whose first word is a path listed in the slice's Files is not refused.
- Real commands are never refused.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli ./internal/tui -count=1 -run 'TestSliceCheckCommandWarningsExemptsAFilesPath|TestSpecDraftRefusesACheckEntryThatIsNotACommand|TestPlanWarnsOnANonCommandCheckEntry|TestRunStartRefusesANonCommandCheckEntry|TestWaveStartRefusesAMemberWithANonCommandCheckEntry|TestSpecCheckReportsNotReadyForANonCommandCheckEntry|TestWaveStartHoldsAnItemWithACheckFinding|TestSpecNoteNamesACheckFinding' -v` exits 0 and lists each new test as PASS.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
